newsitem.title: ESTONIA: C.BANK TO RESTRICT MONEY INFLOW - REPORT.
newsitem.headline: C.BANK TO RESTRICT MONEY INFLOW - REPORT.

text.p: The Estonian Central Bank plans to restrict foreign money inflows next year by applying tighter methods and preparing commercial banks to join European Monetary Union, Aripaev newspaper said on Monday.
Economic results show that banks have difficulties with estimating general economic risks, Aare Jarvan, the head of the central bank's policy department, was quoted as saying.
The goal is to restrict lending opportunities, so that only viable projects are financed, he added.
The central bank does not know yet which methods will be applied, but Jarvan mentioned capital taxation, a ban and restrictions as possible opportunities.
Uhispank capital markets head Margus Kangro said the restrictions will increase the price of money and burden the current account of balance.
The central bank must be more closely related to commercial banks when joining European Monetary Union, Jarvan said.
